blocks.text: Japan will continue to stand behind the International Criminal Court based on its unwavering belief that the rule of law is important, its top government spokesman said Sunday, expressing “deep concerns” about U.S. sanctions on the entity. The sanctions “run counter to Japan’s position,” Chief Cabinet Secretary Minori Kihara said on a TV program, echoing a similar statement made by Prime Minister Sanae Takaichi shortly after the United States, Japan’s longtime ally, moved to sanction the court on Friday. Despite expressing its concerns, Tokyo has largely refrained from outright criticism of the United States or urging it to retract the measures, […]...
